content.comment_body: While attempting to program, an error message appeared: "An unexpected error occurred. Your data may be inconsistent and further errors may occur. java.lang.StackOverflowError. Project cannot be opened." The project size is 247 kB. Relevant environment details include Java(TM) SE Runtime Environment, Java HotSpot(TM) 64-Bit Server VM Version 25.121-b13, and localization set to cs. The Java Home and working directory references [company_name] and [product_name] V8.2. Classpath contains [product_name] libraries and components. INI-file location is C:\Users\[user_name]\.LOGOComfort8.2\Application.ini. Program Version: [version_no] Program Timestamp: 2017-10-24 12-19. Language: en_US, Language Version: 8.1, OS: Windows 10, Processor: amd64. Total Java memory is 230,686 kB, with 140,696 kB free.
Is it possible that the wrong language was installed?

analysis.insight_summary: A user is facing a major Java StackOverflowError when trying to open their project in [product_name] from [company_name], indicating probable data corruption and making the project inaccessible. The only reply is a general suggestion regarding language installation, which does not address the error directly or provide a viable resolution, leaving the user's technical issue unsolved.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to access and work on their project without encountering critical errors or data corruption.
